settings.heading: Made with the grieving heart in mind.
settings.text:
Based in DTX, I organize and create resources with the grieving heart in mind. I've lost quite a few family members, and I built this space so others can find resources to help themselves or a loved one process their grieving journey.

One thing I've noticed: no two grief journeys look the same. Yours won't feel the same as someone else's, and it won't feel the same if you, or someone you love, has lost multiple people or pets in a lifetime.

settings.heading: You're not alone.
settings.text:
Journaling, video blogging and exercise have helped me tremendously. Grief takes many shapes and forms over your lifetime. I picked up journaling and running (I completed my first marathon, woohoo!), but it's tough when you don't have a community.

I hope the tools here, and the space I provide, help you find comfort in knowing you're not alone.

Grief sucks. Death sucks.
